paper_title: Search for Axion Dark Matter from 1.1 to 1.3 GHz with ADMX
notes: New ADMX haloscope search covering 1.10-1.31 GHz (4.54-5.41 ueV) reporting 90% C.L. upper limits on g_agamma with better-than-KSVZ sensitivity (KSVZ excluded even at fractional DM density; DFSZ not reached). Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with Maxwell-Boltzmann lineshape. The paper provides no numerical table of the exclusion limit; only Fig. 3 shows it. Data points above are approximate values estimated at roughly the KSVZ coupling level (g_KSVZ ~ 1.8-2.1e-15 GeV^-1 across this mass range), since the limit is stated to be slightly below KSVZ. Gaps exist at mode crossings. For precise values, digitization of Fig. 3 or the collaboration's data release is needed. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
